1.0.5.summary: This version introduced task management, email and calendar connections, and guidance for getting started.
details: You could find task candidates in email and return to the original messages to check them.
It provided calendar connections for deadlines and task priority sorting.
It included a tutorial for new users and optional iCloud sync settings.
This entry describes the features available at the time and may differ from current connection methods or settings guidance.

1.0.12.summary: Improved calendar navigation and direct editing, recording and audio file imports, task entry, and settings.
details: Improved mobile calendar month, year, and day views, pinch gestures, scrolling, and navigation to today. On Mac, you can create events in empty time, select a time range, and adjust event times by dragging their edges.
Event edits and deletions preserve existing tasks, recurring events, and completion records. Improved protection against deleted events being automatically registered again.

The app shows actual input waveforms and device-specific recording status, and distinguishes transcription failures from original-audio saving failures. Mac audio file import saves and plays audio locally without changing the original.
Reorganized AI, meeting, and task settings, distinguishing Apple's default processing from the support requirements and individual consent for optional models and external analysis.

Improved device-specific indicators for new email, pinned task search and filters, draft retention on foldable screens, double-clicking or double-tapping empty space, and Mac editing buttons and light/dark appearance.

1.0.13.summary: Reduced repeated iCloud authentication and heavy sync workloads, and improved meeting error guidance and reporting.
details: Automatic iCloud sync checks run without authentication prompts. Protected account connection information is handled through a separate authorization action that explains its purpose and progress. Canceling stops remaining work while preserving existing data and credential protections.

Fixed connection information that had already been checked being treated as missing again merely because authentication was pending. Account connection readiness is distinguished from actual completion of app data transfers to iCloud.

Large sync operations now save small changes in bounded batches instead of saving each change individually, reducing disk writes and export requests. Original content and recovery information are preserved through cancellation, failures, and restarts.

Meeting system-audio errors retain their original failure stage and error code, with guidance on Mac capture permissions. The error is included in reports even if diagnostic collection is enabled later.

Diagnostic review and drafts are retained when report composition is canceled or submission fails. HTTP and network errors are distinguished from actual receipt numbers, and diagnostics are marked as delivered only when explicitly consented diagnostics have been received.

1.0.14.summary: Add tasks directly from meeting summary sentences, delete entire meetings, and download audio by source.
details: The add button beside summary sentences classified as tasks saves the sentence unchanged to the review queue. A separate candidate list and task-title re-summarization have been removed, while original-source grounding and duplicate prevention are retained.

When summarizing again, directly choose Apple Intelligence or a connected ChatGPT model. External meeting requests require separate sharing consent, and existing records are preserved on failure or cancellation.

After confirmation in the meeting list, you can delete an entire meeting and all its audio sources. Save an individual source's original ZIP or WAV, or an original ZIP of all sources, while keeping already registered tasks.

Reorganized meeting settings, transcripts, and speaker displays, and strengthened Mac meeting detection and output-device audio capture paths. Detection and recording are separate choices; you must check required system permissions and participant consent.

Added an entry point for advertising consent and privacy settings, and improved account connections, response handling, usage displays, and compatibility with existing cloud deletion records. Actual ad delivery and model classification accuracy are not guaranteed.

1.0.15.summary: Save individual email actions as tasks, compare and restore iCloud conflicts, and navigate the calendar more easily.
details: Only required actions identified in the complete email body become task proposals. Save multiple actions separately, prevent duplicate capture after editing a title, and retain the original email reference.

Periodically cache email lists and complete bodies on the device and reconnect interrupted IMAP sessions on the next fetch. Caching is independent of AI analysis and retains per-device background permission and account boundaries.

Compare conflict versions, choose what to apply, and restore originals retained on the device. Update every device sharing your iCloud account. Version 1.0.14 cannot read the sync format of tasks created from new email action items.

Improved scroll-tracked year and month, width-adaptive multi-day views, and horizontal calendar navigation. All-day events and events lasting at least a day use one continuous bar; shorter timed events remain in each day's timetable.
Refined Mac task and email More menus, task detail buttons, and long email action labels. Advertising privacy forms now distinguish configuration, network, and form-delivery errors.
